name: Filamentworld
summary: Filament seller listed as German by SimplyPrint, offering PLA (standard, matte, silk, metallic silk; about 34 colours), PETG and ABS on 1 kg spools. Likely a shop or private-label brand; the company and manufacturer are unknown.

product_lines.name: PETG
product_lines.notes: Two PETG entries in SpoolmanDB PR #365.

additional_notes: No imprint or company information found. The domain is unresolved: SimplyPrint links filamentworld.com while search results show filamentworld.de, so no endpoint is recorded. An old Hubs forum post names filamentworld.de as a place to buy eSUN filament. A reseller or rebrand link to eSUN is therefore rumoured and uncorroborated, and it is not encoded. Price tier unknown.

provenance.conflicts: Germany as headquarters comes only from the SimplyPrint brand page and is not verified by an imprint. Website domain (.de vs .com) unresolved.
